questions.text: What should happen when up and down are pressed simultaneously?
questions.default: Cancel simultaneous up and down events; a simultaneous centre event clears the counter.
questions.reason: The request does not define arbitration; cancellation avoids silently favoring one direction.
questions.answer: Up takes priority over down, so the counter increments. If clear is pressed at the same time, clear takes priority and the counter is set to 0.
questions.evidence: If several presses land on the same clock, only the highest priority acts - clear, then up, then down.

questions.text: Should brightness 255 be full-on or one PWM step below full-on?
questions.default: Treat 255 as full-on and zero as fully off.
questions.reason: This gives intuitive endpoints for a user-set brightness value.
questions.answer: One PWM step below full-on: duty 255 is on for 255/256 of the time.
questions.evidence: DUTY_EFF = 0 is fully off; 255 is on 255/256 of the time.

questions.text: What reset value and polarity should the control bits use?
questions.default: CONTROL bit 0 resets clear (UART brightness selected), and bit 1 resets set (display enabled).
questions.reason: The request leaves reset values open; these defaults show the display and use the stated UART brightness by default.
questions.answer: CTRL resets to 0x2: DUTY_SRC (bit 0) is 0, selecting the DUTY register; DISPLAY_EN (bit 1) is 1, enabling the display. Their specified logic semantics are active-high for selecting switches and enabling the display.
